shortDescription: Gathers facts from a network device via napalm

options.name: args
options.description: dictionary of kwargs arguments to pass to the filter. The outer key is the name of the getter (same as the filter)

options.name: filter
options.description: A list of facts to retreive from a device and provided though C(ansible_facts) The list of facts available are maintained at: http://napalm.readthedocs.io/en/latest/support/ Note- not all getters are implemented on all supported device types

options.name: hostname
options.description: IP or FQDN of the device you want to connect to

options.name: ignore_notimplemented
options.description: Ignores NotImplementedError for filters which aren't supported by the driver. Returns invalid filters in a list called: not_implemented

options.name: optional_args
options.description: Dictionary of additional arguments passed to underlying driver

options.name: provider
options.description: Dictionary which acts as a collection of arguments used to define the characteristics of how to connect to the device. Note - hostname, username, password and dev_os must be defined in either provider or local param Note - local param takes precedence, e.g. hostname is preferred to provider['hostname']

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time in seconds to wait for the device to respond
